topic: Product-name screen for a Windows desktop AI coding assistant: is there an obvious conflict for Moonwright, Lunarch, Perilune, Selunara or Tidewright as the name of an AI coding assistant or developer software (US trademark index, web search, GitHub, .com domain)
notes: Run 1 (8 pages, about 8 credits of the project's 20; phase 0 was a dry run and spent nothing; Firecrawl balance 346 before, from doctor). No queries: a Firecrawl search costs about 2 credits and keeps no capture of its result list, so an absence could not be shown; each web search is instead a search results page fetched by URL, which is captured. Sources follow the sibling project docs/research/2026-10-12-selenic-name-check: Justia's trademark search (rendered for selenic, full capture), GitHub's stars-sorted repository search (rendered). The five names go into ONE GitHub query joined with OR (GitHub allows up to five operators), per_page 100, to spend 1 credit instead of 5; if total_count passes 100 a per-name follow-up decides. Web search engine: none was captured in the sibling project; a planning curl on 2026-10-12 (not evidence) found Bing serving unrelated results to a non-browser client, Google answering with a JavaScript-required page and DuckDuckGo refusing the container's proxy, so this run probes two engines on Moonwright only - Google (Firecrawl renders JavaScript) and DuckDuckGo lite (the kit's own keyless search endpoint, lib/http-transport.mjs) - and run 2 uses whichever rendered results for the other four names. RDAP (.com) is held for run 2, so a name whose trademark or web search already shows a clear conflict can skip it. A planning DNS lookup on 2026-10-12 (dns.google, not evidence) found all five .com names delegated, so each RDAP lookup is expected to answer 200 with a record.

urls.why: U-01: every US trademark filing whose text contains MOONWRIGHT, from Justia's index of USPTO data - owner, class, status
U-02: every US trademark filing whose text contains LUNARCH, from Justia's index of USPTO data - owner, class, status
U-03: every US trademark filing whose text contains PERILUNE, from Justia's index of USPTO data - owner, class, status
U-04: every US trademark filing whose text contains SELUNARA, from Justia's index of USPTO data - owner, class, status
U-05: every US trademark filing whose text contains TIDEWRIGHT, from Justia's index of USPTO data - owner, class, status
U-01, U-02, U-03, U-04, U-05: every GitHub repository matching any of the five names, most-starred first - the top repository and its stars per name
U-01: one web search for Moonwright with software or AI - a current software or AI product or company using the name (probe: does this engine render results through this transport)
U-01: the same web search on DuckDuckGo lite - a current software or AI product or company using the name (probe: does this engine render results through this transport)
